title: Choices v1
description: choices.json in the app data folder (SPEC 6.8): the user's timestamped build-order and decoration choices, the third input of world = grow(seed, ledger, choices). Added by WP-01 because the spec names the file but not its shape (see contracts/CHANGES.md). An append-only log so the weekly replay is exact: the state at any moment is the fold of entries up to it. Written only by the core, atomically.

log.description: Oldest first. An empty log means the default build order (SPEC 4.5 table order) and no decorations toggled.

ms.description: Milliseconds since the Unix epoch (UTC), always an integer. The range (2000-01-01 to 2100-01-01) rejects a seconds value passed by mistake.

decoration.description: Decoration id from the economy config (WP-08 owns the catalogue of 24).

day.description: Local day when the choice was made, so grow() never needs a time zone.

order.description: The user's priority order. Structures not listed keep their default order after the listed ones.

on.description: true to place it (buying it if not yet owned), false to put it away.
